events.cross-guild-bounties: Buggy is named an Emperor and Cross Guild receives bounties: Mihawk 3,590M, Buggy 3,189M, Crocodile 1,965M.
events.straw-hat-bounties-post-wano: New bounties after Wano: Luffy 3,000M, Zoro 1,111M, Jinbe 1,100M, Sanji 1,032M, Robin 930M, Usopp 500M, Franky 394M, Brook 383M, Nami 366M, Chopper 1,000.
events.egghead-arrival: The Straw Hats arrive at Future Island Egghead.
events.law-vs-blackbeard: Blackbeard defeats Law and the Heart Pirates on Winner Island.
events.lucci-awakening: Rob Lucci shows his awakened Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard.
events.luffy-vs-lucci-egghead: Luffy in Gear 5 faces the awakened Lucci.
events.stussy-betrayal: Stussy takes down Kaku and Lucci: she is Vegapunk's spy.
events.york-traitor: York turns out to be the traitor among the satellites.
events.shanks-vs-eustass-kid: Shanks defeats Kid with a single blow (Kamusari) at Elbaph.
events.garp-rescues-koby: Garp storms Hachinosu to rescue Koby.
events.kuzan-blackbeard-captain: Kuzan appears as captain of Blackbeard's Tenth Ship.
events.buggy-one-piece-declaration: Buggy declares that Cross Guild is going after the One Piece.
events.cobra-death-imu: Imu reveals itself to Cobra, who dies in Mary Geoise.
events.lulusia-destruction: Imu orders the destruction of Lulusia with the Mother Flame.
events.garp-vs-kuzan: Garp falls to Kuzan so that Koby can escape (his last lesson).
events.saturn-arrives: Saint Jaygarcia Saturn of the Five Elders appears on Egghead.
events.vegapunk-death: Kizaru fatally wounds the original Vegapunk.
events.kuma-past: Kuma's flashback: God Valley, Ginny and Bonney.
events.kuma-vs-saturn: Kuma strikes Saturn to save Bonney.
events.egghead-buster-call: A Buster Call is invoked on Egghead.
events.giant-warrior-pirates-arrive: Dorry and Brogy arrive with the Giant Warrior Pirates.
events.vegapunk-broadcast: The worldwide broadcast of Vegapunk's message begins.
events.five-elders-transform: The Five Elders arrive on Egghead in their beast forms.
events.joy-boy-reveal: Vegapunk speaks about Joy Boy and the Void Century.
events.bonney-nika: Bonney takes on her Nika form from her Distorted Future.
events.luffy-conquerors-haki-egghead: Luffy's Conqueror's Haki, combined with the giants', knocks out the Marines.
events.egghead-escape: The Straw Hats escape Egghead, bound for Elbaph.
